svg.aria-label: Winner: FOSS Hack 2026, with a Rs 1,00,000 prize. LibreMP: we reverse-engineered Epson's projector protocol from packet captures, so Linux and macOS can cast too. Top 13: FortyGuard Hackathon 2026, among teams from 50+ countries. SatAlite: predicts how a concrete pour cures, from satellite temperature data and a 2D finite-difference heat solver. Top 100: Meta PyTorch OpenEnv Hackathon, out of 32,000+ participants. Memex: an RL-trained agent that investigates money-laundering cases across 18 tools. Top 500: Amazon ML Challenge 2026, out of 20,000+ participants. Top 10: Sahyadri Coastal Innovation Hackathon 2026, national finalist.
